articles.author: Dan Lamothe
articles.title: U.S. general warns Pentagon he lacks sufficient forces to protect Israel - washingtonpost.com
articles.description: A shortage of Navy destroyers, used to defend against Iranian ballistic missile attacks, will force the head of U.S. European Command to prioritize the U.S. homeland instead, officials said.
articles.content: The top U.S. general in Europe privately warned the Pentagon this week that he lacks sufficient naval forces to continue protecting Israel from incoming ballistic missiles, officials said, illustrati… [+67 chars]
